info.prompt: Ultra-detailed sci-fi illustration of a neural cathedral game board, where paladin-class dice emit a sacred gold glow against bio-mechanical HUD edges. Electric magenta progress bars drain from green to red during combo breaks, detonating in white-screen flashes when reversed. Gothic arches of bone-like circuitry frame the scene, with vignette blur pulling focus to the center. Alchemical amber highlights trace ancient runes on cyberpunk dice facets.
